name: Hellfire Stirrups raises the Xorothian Warsteed's speed by 75% (#9850)
contract: Hellfire Stirrups 804785 requires Xorothian Warsteed 804703 (CasterAuraSpell) and promises +75% mount speed.
The Warsteed is a learned mount, so its own effect 0 (same aura) is set from riding skill: 150 gives 100%.
The core keeps only the largest MOD_INCREASE_MOUNTED_SPEED amount, so a bare 75 loses to the mount's 100.
Expected: the Stirrups effect carries the mount's 100 plus its 75, giving 175% and a run speed rate of at
least 2.75 while Path of Hellfire stacks (a separate non-stacking multiplier) can only raise it further.
Before the fix the Stirrups amount is 75 and the mounted speed stays at the Warsteed's own 100%.

steps.label: Let login and level scaling settle
the Warsteed runs at the riding-skill 100%
let the mount's global cooldown run out
Stirrups adds its 75% on top of the mount's 100%
the mounted run speed reflects at least 175%
